subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

Leopards and cats __are belong__ to the same family of animals.
solution:
The correct answer is 'belong'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies incorrect usage of 'are'.
 
• Let's take a look at the sentence, the sentence is giving an information or fact about Leopards and cats. It isn't stating any action. 
 
• Simple Present tense: It is used to describe something that happens regularly in the present or something that is always true.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject+ the first form of verb
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• I play football every weekend.
 
• The human body contains 206 bones.
 
 
 
• Thus, '**belong**' will be used in place of 'are belong'.

 

Correct sentence:__ *Leopards and cats __**belong**__ to the same family of animals. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ** Linking verb: ** A linking verb is a verb “that serves as a connecting link or establishes an identity between subject and complement.
